artifacts.summary: Before/after noise measurement (structural, key-parity, and live arms), full residual-noise inventory by source and extension, and the two required out-of-scope facts (OpenCode content-flavor gap; .opencode/extensions/ mirror interaction).

completion_data.completion_summary: Repointed all 12 agent-system/extensions/*/opencode-agents.json fragments' {file:...} references from unpopulated .opencode/agent/subagents/ (and lean's bogus .claude/extensions/lean/agents/) to .claude/agents/, fixed present's stale slides-agent.md basename and slides->slides-research key rename, and converted merge.lua's validate_opencode_fragment/generate_opencode_json pair from fail-fast/per-fragment to report-all/per-agent-key degradation. Live end-to-end measurement confirmed WARN lines fell from 2 to 0 and agent-key count rose from 9 to 13 for the extensions loaded in this repo; structural basename-vs-manifest mismatches fell from 1 to 0 across all 12 fragments. Residual verify.lua key-parity noise for epidemiology, lean, and present was enumerated by source and extension for the sibling task.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lua fragment/config-merge validator's failure discards an entire batch for one bad reference (fail-fast + per-batch degradation), the fix has two independent halves: (1) make the validator collect ALL misses (sort keys before iterating pairs() for determinism) and return a per-item miss map as an additional return value rather than forcing the caller to re-parse an error string; (2) make the caller consult that miss map to skip only the individual offending item(s), preserving first-writer-wins semantics for the rest. Verify both halves with a headless harness using a synthetic fragment with one good + one bad reference, asserting the good one merges and only the bad one is named in the warning.

In this repo's extension system, driving generate_opencode_json (or any config.claude()/config.opencode()-gated generator) headlessly for measurement requires: (1) create a temporary opencode.json.managed marker at project root (the function no-ops without it), (2) patch vim.schedule to run its callback synchronously since scheduled vim.notify(WARN) calls won't fire within a single -c luafile invocation's event loop tick, (3) capture vim.notify calls by wrapping it before the call, (4) delete opencode.json and opencode.json.managed afterward and confirm git status --porcelain is clean of new root files.
